On 8 November 2029 at 08.40 in Friedrichshain, bube Berlin analyst Clara Weiß (34) was found dead on the sofa in her third-floor flat. When she did not come to work, branch head Ute Sommer called; when there was no answer, the caretaker opened the door.

The flat ransacked, the balcony door open, the laptop missing. Patrol note: “Identical to the balcony burglary series that has been going on in the area for two months. The burglar surprised Clara asleep and strangled her when she woke.”

8 November, afternoon: Kevin Schulz was caught selling Clara Weiß’s laptop at a second-hand shop.

BURGLARY SERIES FILE — FRIEDRICHSHAIN

The autopsy showed the time of death and that the drawers were rifled hours later; the entrance camera showed a man with a lanyard inside at the time of death, and the entrance empty at two in the night. The ‘don’t go to Ute tomorrow’ the neighbour heard, the inside-source file in the cloud log, the cell site record and the skin cells on the lanyard closed the chain.
A real crime is the best place to hide another one. Before treating an incident as one event, separate its times.
Friedrichshain, Berlin — November 2029

Since 2028 bube Berlin analyst Matthias Kern had been taking monthly payments from Arendt Handelsgesellschaft. His colleague Clara Weiß found out and was going to the branch head. On the night of 7 November Kern went to Clara’s home, strangled her with his lanyard and left the balcony door open; from the burglary series he himself was running, he knew Kevin Schulz would come to the next block. Schulz came at two in the night, found the dead woman, took the laptop and fled.
Who is responsible for Clara Weiß’s death?
